blurb:
At the heart of Calle Ocho, the aroma of hand-rolled tobacco and aged spirits define the atmosphere. While Miami is famous for beaches, this historic district is where Caribbean craftsmanship truly lives.

Our 3-hour Cigar & Rum Tour immerses you in the artisanal traditions of Little Havana. Tracing the journey from tobacco fields to copper stills, you'll discover how these twin crafts became symbols of Cuban heritage.

Meet master rollers safeguarding "totalmente a mano" techniques passed through generations. To complement the leaf, enjoy curated food pairings and premium rum cocktails. Each stop highlights the balance between a premium cigar's earthy notes and the tropical complexity of an authentic Caribbean pour.

Against a backdrop of rhythmic music, learn the nuances of blending and aging. Explore the neighborhood's sophisticated spirit; arrive with a curious palate and leave with the refined perspective of a true aficionado.
